read_only_review.enemy_only_lookup: EnemyActionCard and WildlifeMechanics.Card are used in intent, details, combat history, effects and audio; GameDatabase.Card stays null for animal skills.
read_only_review.player_isolation: Draft and random rewards use GameDatabase.Cards. Subject/event card additions validate GameDatabase.Card. CanPlayCard and CanClaimCard reject injected animal IDs.
read_only_review.save_scaling: Mutation is independently fixed per map node. Only StartBattle applies HP scaling. Save constructor preserves spawned combat stats and variant, including legacy active ordinary encounters.
read_only_review.intent_execution: Natural animal plans contain a single special on boar turns 2/4/etc or bear turns 3/6/etc; shared damage and interruption helpers match actual resolution. Mutant basic damage is also shared.
read_only_review.minor_cosmetic_observation: CombatEffects attack predicate includes card.damage for wildlife_interrupt/wildlife_despair, so generic reaction particles may appear at the player while the status text correctly appears over the animal. Reported to root without editing during build.
read_only_review.cosmetic_observation_resolution: Fixed before final native verification: wildlife_interrupt and wildlife_despair are treated as source reactions; their particles appear at the animal. Runtime compilation passed again after the minimal visual patch.
